text.p: These are the stories making headlines in the Namibian newspapers. Reuter does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Breaking the Wall of Silence Organisation has called on the Council of Churches in Namibia to hold the long-planned reconciliation conference, which the ruling party SWAPO has promised to boycott.

- An ad-hoc cabinet committee has been tasked with finding a final solution to the problems of People's Liberation Army of Namibia-combatants, who this week staged a protest, calling on the president to address their plight.
- The impact-study on the proposed Epupa hydro-electric scheme will determine whether the Norwegian Development Organisation (NORAD) will help Namibia finance the project.
